subject: alt-ft
title: ALT.FT.------POL.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 435 (MP(I)-9). ALT-FT (alternative functionalism) is the subject; POL-DY (political dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: ACT (activism), INFO-TRNS (information transference) and LK-IMP (linkage implications). From ACT: UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)) and DIS-C-CT (disintegration of a culture’s center). From INFO-TRNS: RT-ALGN (reality alignment). From LK-IMP: TRS (transition). From UNF-PI: ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism). From RT-ALGN: SOC-RT-INT (social reality interpretation). From SOC-RT-INT: DEF (definition).
